user.title: Connect your Rouvy account
user.description: Sign in with the email and password you use on riders.rouvy.com. If you only sign in with Google, Apple, or Facebook, first set a password under Security on account.rouvy.com.

data_description.email: Email address of your Rouvy account.
data_description.password: Your Rouvy password. Home Assistant stores it and uses it only to sign in to Rouvy.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Rouvy again
reauth_confirm.description: Rouvy no longer accepts the saved password for {email}. Enter the current password.

reconfigure.title: Update Rouvy password
reconfigure.description: Enter the current Rouvy password for {email}.

error.invalid_auth: Rouvy did not accept this email and password.
error.rate_limited: Rouvy is temporarily blocking sign-in attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.blocked: The Rouvy firewall rejected the request. Rouvy may have changed its site; check for an integration update.
error.auth_flow_changed: Rouvy accepted the password but did not start a session. Rouvy may have changed its sign-in flow; check for an integration update.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Rouvy. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Rouvy account is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: A Rouvy account is already set up. Only one account is supported.

auth_failed.message: Rouvy rejected the saved credentials. Sign in again to keep the integration working.

not_loaded.message: The Rouvy integration is not loaded. Check that the account is set up and online.

profile_update_empty.message: Provide at least one profile field to change.

update_weight.name: Update weight
update_weight.description: Changes your body weight in Rouvy.

update_units.name: Update units
update_units.description: Switches Rouvy between metric and imperial units.

update_settings.name: Update body settings
update_settings.description: Changes weight, height, and/or units in one call.

settings.name: Settings
settings.description: Any of weight (kg), height (cm), and units (METRIC or IMPERIAL).

update_profile.name: Update profile
update_profile.description: Changes profile details and account privacy. Fields you leave out keep their current values.

first_name.name: First name
first_name.description: First name shown on your profile.

last_name.name: Last name
last_name.description: Last name shown on your profile.

country.name: Country
country.description: Two-letter country code, for example US.

account_privacy.name: Account privacy
account_privacy.description: Whether other riders can see your account.

update_timezone.name: Update timezone
update_timezone.description: Changes the timezone Rouvy uses for your account.

update_ftp.name: Update FTP
update_ftp.description: Sets a manual FTP or switches back to the Rouvy estimate.

ftp_source.name: FTP source
ftp_source.description: MANUAL to set a value, ESTIMATED to let Rouvy estimate it.

value.name: FTP
value.description: FTP in watts. Required when the source is MANUAL.

update_zones.name: Update zones
update_zones.description: Replaces power or heart rate zone boundaries.

zones.name: Boundaries
zones.description: Increasing zone boundaries in percent, for example [55, 75, 90, 105, 120, 150].

update_max_heart_rate.name: Update max heart rate
update_max_heart_rate.description: Changes your maximum heart rate, keeping your zone boundaries.

max_heart_rate.name: Max heart rate
max_heart_rate.description: Maximum heart rate in beats per minute.

slug.name: Challenge
slug.description: Challenge identifier from the challenge URL.

unregister_event.name: Leave event
unregister_event.description: Cancels your registration for an event.

get_career.name: Get career
get_career.description: Returns career level, XP, achievements, and trophies.
